name: 1Zpresso K-Plus
details: Hand grinder with external numbered dial, 100 clicks per rotation (dial reading = clicks ÷ 10). All-rounder, espresso-capable.

grindRanges.scale: clicks from zero (burrs closed); dial number = clicks ÷ 10

notes.moka: 1Zpresso groups moka pot with AeroPress and drip coffee maker.
notes.aeropress: 1Zpresso groups AeroPress, moka pot and drip coffee maker.

rangeInfo.note: 1Zpresso “K-Pro/K-Max/K-Plus Grind Setting Reference” chart (K-series-Grind-Setting-Reference-211129.jpg on that page), in dial points: Turkish 2–3.5, espresso 3–4.5, AeroPress/moka/drip coffee maker 5–7, siphon/pour over 8–9, French press 9–10. “Each of the ten clicks between each whole number allows for extremely fine adjustment.”
rangeInfo.estimateNote: Estimated by extrapolating the cited ranges, not from the source: Rapid Brewer: from the middle of the AeroPress range to the middle of the pour-over range; cold brew: the French press range moved half its width coarser. Dial in from there.
